reviewer.name: ChatGPT
reviewer.scope: Direct browser, screenshot, accessibility, source and saved-record inspection. This is an interactive AI review, not a paid API verdict or a human sign-off.

visual_review.coverage: Desktop rendered review for all nine paths. Narrow review of home, all three articles, sources, enquiry and sourcing dialog in a 360px iframe (345px content with scrollbar). This is responsive layout review, not touch/device emulation or real-buyer testing.
checks: Contextual article and question links preserve the reviewed reading
Source search returns the scoped exact 140 cm width and its citation
Unknown commercial terms stay explicitly unconfirmed
Pagefind wool query returned two matching articles
Unsent brief download contains selected questions and remains explicitly unsent
Actual local Worker/SQLite enquiry receipt and reload restoration observed
Switching to supplier context clears the prefilled product; clear-context and remove-attribution controls work
No horizontal overflow in observed desktop and narrow layouts
Mobile navigation targets measured at 44px high; source disclosure measured 68.78px high
Dialog Escape closes and returns focus to its opener
resolved_findings: Reduced mobile header copy while preserving full accessible names
Collapsed repeated source explanations and full question prompts
Enlarged mobile brand, theme toggle and source disclosure targets
Changed pre-submit copy to describe what submission will do

media.licensed_photo_path: Implemented with rights-scope, expiry and revocation checks; acceptance uses synthetic grant fixtures, not a real commercial licence.
media.review_binding: Current image bytes, generation prompt/provider/model, article identity and visible disclosures are bound to an interactive AI review receipt.

conversion.environment: Local real Worker + SQLite, not hosted D1
conversion.hosted_current_version_acceptance: PASS for browser save, reload and native D1 context read-back; see explicit limits in hosted-v4-acceptance.json

synthetic_editions.scope: Actual check/build/output and durable worker acceptance. Fixture editions preceded final cosmetic mobile polish. Current enterprise Playwright suite was not executed.

verification.hosted_ci: Not claimed green; prior GitHub runner allocation was blocked by account billing.

release_policy_change: Private review may switch to public indexing with the same reviewed source fingerprint. Canonical, robots, output and release gates are checked again after the switch.

external_connections.live_ai: UNCONFIGURED: no compatible deployed sessions/chat service has been verified
external_connections.paid_image_generation_and_review_apis: UNCONFIGURED: provider integration exercised with fixtures; current concept images reviewed directly

notes: Synthetic QA records and validation traffic are not customer demand.
Receipt recovery is limited to received successful receipts in the same browser tab.
No supplier contact, order, quotation confirmation or automatic content publication occurred.
